{{Quote|Remember that the Guild Museum and Library holds thousands of biographies and instructional datatapes.|Kenek Weeyo mentions the Museum and Library in his chapter of ''The Bounty Hunter Code''|<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett">''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]''</ref>}}
The '''Bounty Hunters Guild Museum and Library''' was a location owned by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]] which acted as a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] and a [[Library/Legends|library]] for members of the organization. The building held thousands of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]' biographies, as well as instructional [[Data-tape/Legends|datatapes]], all meant for use as a learning resources for bounty hunters in the Guild. The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Kenek Weeyo]] worked as [[Chief Custodian]] of the Museum and Library for many [[Standard year/Legends|years]], and at some point following the [[Order 66/Legends|fall]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], contributed a chapter to ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code]]'', a manual given to all guild members, in which he encouraged visits to the building.<ref name="The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bounty Hunters Guild Museum and Library was first mentioned in ''[[The Bounty Hunter Code: From the Files of Boba Fett]]'', a reference book written by [[Jason Fry]], [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Ryder Windham]] in [[2014]].
